overview: Ground-plus-one villas are arranged around private plots, with two façade styles advertised by Modon.
Brochure editions use different area measurements; confirm the contracted specification.
research.locationNote: Al Naseem Community on Hudayriyat Island, Abu Dhabi; confirm the plot and access routes on the selected plan.
research.priceNote: Modon’s FAQ lists four-bedroom villas from AED 7.8 million; its project facts list five-bedroom homes from AED 9 million and six-bedroom homes from AED 10 million. Obtain a current unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Modon publishes 40/60. A broker-transcribed historical calendar ends on 1 March 2028; its original developer PDF was not retrieved, so it is not a new booking schedule.
research.handoverNote: The project FAQ targets first-phase Q4 2027, while Modon’s central FAQ also lists Q4 2026. A broker’s historical payment calendar references March 2028. Confirm the applicable phase and contracted date.

facts.label: Brochure plots
facts.value: Illustrated average plots: 750 m² for 4BR; 930 m² for 5BR and 6BR. Plot area is separate from building area.

facts.label: Ownership
facts.value: Modon advertises freehold ownership for all nationalities; confirm the selected property’s title and terms.
